Dashboard_Control: Appointment letter, photo ID, service book and worker register
Key_Requirement: Maintain employment documentation and employee/worker records.
Applicability: Non-EPZ establishments within the Act's scope
Verification_Note: Check the consolidated law and the 2026 amendment before operational use.

Key_Requirement: 120 days total maternity benefit/leave (60 days before and 60 days after), subject to statutory eligibility and conditions.
Applicability: Eligible female workers under the Act
Verification_Note: Eligibility, living-child condition and payment procedure must be reviewed case-by-case.

Dashboard_Control: Daily/weekly hours, rest breaks and weekly holiday
Key_Requirement: Normally 8 hours/day and 48 hours/week; statutory limits and rest/weekly holiday controls apply.
Verification_Note: Sector permissions and special categories may differ.

Key_Requirement: Overtime allowance is payable at twice the ordinary rate for the specified wage components.
Applicability: Workers performing overtime under the Act
Verification_Note: The workbook uses a configurable demo hourly divisor; verify the applicable rules and wage components.

Dashboard_Control: Casual, sick, earned and festival leave
Key_Requirement: 10 days casual leave; 14 days sick leave; earned leave rules; 13 paid festival holidays.
Applicability: Workers under the Act, subject to category exceptions
Verification_Note: Tea garden, newspaper and minor-worker rules differ.

Dashboard_Control: Wage period, payment deadline and payment method
Key_Requirement: Wage period cannot exceed one month; wages are generally payable within seven working days after the wage period.
Verification_Note: Termination dues and exceptional cases have separate timelines.

Key_Requirement: Use the current government gazette for the applicable industry, grade and location.
Verification_Note: There is no single universal private-sector floor in this model; update Configured_Wage_Floor.

Dashboard_Control: Workers' profit participation and welfare funds
Key_Requirement: Eligible companies/establishments must assess WPPF and welfare-fund obligations.
Applicability: Only establishments meeting statutory applicability conditions
Verification_Note: Confirm applicability, net-profit base, fund ratios and tax treatment with specialists.

Dashboard_Control: Supporting registers, leave/payroll forms and inspection evidence
Key_Requirement: Maintain prescribed forms, registers and implementation evidence.
Verification_Note: Use the amended 2022 rules and current DIFE instructions.

Key_Requirement: The 2026 amendment updates multiple employment, leave, worker and enforcement provisions.
Applicability: Where the Bangladesh Labour Act applies
Verification_Note: Read with the consolidated Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006.

Key_Requirement: Apply current tax-year rules, exemptions, rebates and salary withholding requirements.
Applicability: Taxable employees and responsible withholding entities
Verification_Note: The demo tax values are not a legal tax calculator.

Key_Requirement: Use the current withholding rules, forms and remittance/reporting process.
Verification_Note: Validate the latest NBR rules and amendment before payroll finalisation.

Verification_Note: Do not apply the non-EPZ dashboard thresholds without checking the EPZ law.
